# Blackstorm Experts

> Expert witness sourcing for plaintiff and defense litigation firms. Qualified, vetted experts delivered in 48-72 hours at a flat rate. No payment until we deliver. Satisfaction guaranteed: if the expert is not the right fit after the introduction, we run a new search at no additional charge.

## About

Blackstorm Experts sources and vets expert witnesses for litigation attorneys nationwide. Each search delivers a candidate packet with CVs and fee schedules. One flat fee per expert type. Attorneys engage and pay experts directly.

- [About](https://blackstormexperts.com/about)
- [For Experts](https://blackstormexperts.com/become-expert)
- [As Seen On](https://blackstormexperts.com/as-seen-on)

## How It Works

An attorney sends the case details and the type of expert needed. Blackstorm sources candidates, screens them for relevant experience and testifying history, and confirms availability and fee structure. The attorney receives a packet with CVs and fee schedules, then selects who to engage. Blackstorm makes the introduction and the attorney contracts directly with the expert. Fees are charged at the point of connection.
